researchNotes: Range from hermes.com (USA) fragrance category page (40 of 177 products loaded, perfumes only kept) and Hermessence collection page (19 perfumes, concentrations stated per product). hermes.com product pages returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so no official notes were read. Notes come from the Olfastory database (olfastory.com brand page and perfume pages, opened) and are 'reported'. Fragrantica returned 403. Hermessence entries other than Ginseng Biloba have concentration and collection only (notes not obtained from any opened page). Entries with a listing-only source have notes []. Country not stated on any opened page. Olfastory brand page lists 12 Hermès perfumes and links to further pages that were not opened, so the list is incomplete (Rouge Hermès, 24 Faubourg EDP, H24 EDT, Eau d'Hermès, Twilly d'Hermès EDT, Hermessence notes and others not covered). Terre d'Hermès Eau de Toilette (2006, Ellena) notes come from Olfastory's description of the three stages of the composition.

fragrances.name: Terre d'Hermès
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scent Grail review: 6-8 hours with moderate projection, spring and autumn daytime wear; Basenotes reviewers split (about 8 hours for one, short-lived for others).

fragrances.name: Terre d'Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense

sources.name: Olfastory - Terre d'Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense

fragrances.name: Terre d'Hermès Parfum

sources.name: Off The Record — Hermès Terre d'Hermès Parfum review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Off The Record review: moderate projection, about arm's length for 3-4 hours then skin scent; longevity a solid 8-10 hours.

fragrances.name: Jour d'Hermès Absolu
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Naina.co blogger: lasts really long on skin, clothes carry it 2-3 days, heavy sillage that does not overpower a room; mostly for summer but fine in winter.

fragrances.name: Barénia Pleine Fleur

sources.name: Vivir — Hermès Barénia Pleine Fleur review
Hello Beauty Blog — Hermès Barénia Pleine Fleur

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: 6-8 hours on skin, moderate projection (arm's length for two hours) and sillage; Hello Beauty Blog: 7-10 hours, moderate sillage.

fragrances.name: H24 Herbes Vives

sources.name: iFragrance — Hermès H24 Herbes Vives review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: iFragrance review: about 10 hours on skin with moderate projection for most of its life, needs heat; a spring and summer scent.

fragrances.name: 24 Faubourg Eau de Toilette

sources.name: ScentVerdict — 24 Faubourg Eau de Toilette review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: ScentVerdict: lasts about 6-10 hours, moderate projection that fills a room without taking it over; autumn wear, formal evenings.

fragrances.name: Un Jardin sous la Mer

sources.name: Olfastory - Un Jardin sous la Mer
Avis Parfums — Un Jardin sous la Mer d'Hermès

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Avis Parfums (French blog): 5-6 hours at most on skin; very discreet, an intimate scent barely noticeable at 50 cm.

fragrances.name: Un Jardin à Cythère

sources.name: Twindly — Hermès Un Jardin à Cythère review
The Scentaur — Un Jardin à Cythère review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Twindly: wears close to the skin, gone after about five hours, loved in summer; The Scentaur: faint and linear, almost negligible after four to five hours.

fragrances.name: Twilly d'Hermès

sources.name: Nina's Style Blog — Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau de Parfum review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Nina's Style Blog: longevity about 8-9 hours on the blogger's skin.

fragrances.name: Un Jardin sur le Nil

sources.name: Best Men's Colognes — Un Jardin Sur Le Nil
The Scentaur — Un Jardin sur le Nil review
Perfume Picks — Hermès Un Jardin Sur Le Nil

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Best Men's Colognes: 6-7.5 hours, strong early projection (about 7 ft) then moderate, spring/summer daytime; The Scentaur: about ten hours including skin-scent tail, small projection; Basenotes: 5 hours.

fragrances.name: Eau des Merveilles Bleue

sources.name: Now Smell This — Hermès Eau des Merveilles Bleue review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Now Smell This: considerably more sillage and somewhat more staying power than the other Merveilles; reviewer still detected it after 6 hours; could work in summer for outdoor activities.

fragrances.name: L'Ombre des Merveilles

sources.name: Vivir — Hermès L'Ombre des Merveilles review
Perfume Picks — Hermès L'Ombre Des Merveilles

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: 6-8 hours, moderate projection (arm's length for two hours); Silloria community summary: 6-10 hours, moderate sillage, best in spring and fall.

fragrances.name: L'Ambre des Merveilles

sources.name: ScentVerdict — L'Ambre des Merveilles Eau de Parfum
Bois de Jasmin — Hermès L'Ambre des Merveilles

fragrances.performanceEvidence: ScentVerdict: lasts about 4-6 hours, arm's-length projection, best in autumn and winter; Bois de Jasmin: lasted a full day with two generous sprays but less for another tester.

fragrances.name: Oud Alezan

sources.name: ScentVerdict — Hermessence Oud Alezan Eau de Parfum

fragrances.performanceEvidence: ScentVerdict: lasts about 4-6 hours, arm's-length reach, moderate strength; best in spring and autumn (autumn best), suited to office and evenings.

fragrances.name: Ambre Narguilé

sources.name: The Scentaur — Ambre Narguile Eau de Toilette review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewers: moderate sillage, great longevity of twelve hours, lasts all day; The Scentaur: 12-24 hours but very faint, intimate skin scent; a comforting winter/autumn scent.

fragrances.name: Agar Ébène

sources.name: ScentVerdict — Hermessence Agar Ebene Eau de Toilette

fragrances.performanceEvidence: ScentVerdict: about 2-4 hours, arm's length, best in spring and autumn; Basenotes reviewers: soft sillage and weak projection, five hours (another: skin scent after four hours).

fragrances.name: Rose Ikebana

sources.name: ScentVerdict — Hermessence Rose Ikebana Eau de Toilette

fragrances.performanceEvidence: ScentVerdict: 4-6 hours, arm's-length projection, best in spring and summer; Basenotes reviewers: about 4-5 hours, sillage close to moderate.

fragrances.name: Myrrhe Églantine
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewers: moderate sillage, good projection, six to eight hours, lasts all day with moderate projection; seen as a spring casual scent.

fragrances.name: Épice Marine

sources.name: ScentVerdict — Hermessence Epice Marine Eau de Toilette

fragrances.performanceEvidence: ScentVerdict: 4-6 hours, arm's length, best in spring and summer; Basenotes reviewer: soft sillage, good projection, five hours (another found it weak).

fragrances.name: Poivre Samarcande
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewers: soft sillage, adequate projection, about five hours (another says about 5 hours, no sillage after 30 minutes); suggested for warmer spring days.

fragrances.name: Santal Massoïa
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewer: moderate sillage, adequate projection, six hours; reviews vary widely (from gone in 2 hours to about ten hours).

fragrances.name: Cuir d'Ange

sources.name: Now Smell This — Hermès Cuir d'Ange

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewers: nine to ten hours on skin, sillage close to moderate (one reports over 20 hours); Now Smell This: not a powerhouse in sillage or lasting power; suggested for warmer autumn days.

fragrances.name: Osmanthe Yunnan

sources.name: Now Smell This — Hermès Osmanthe Yunnan

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewers: soft sillage, close to skin, 4.5 to 8 hours depending on skin, a restrained spring scent that needs heat; Now Smell This: little sillage but clings to sleeves.

fragrances.name: Vetiver Tonka

sources.name: Australian Perfume Junkies — Vetiver Tonka by Hermès

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Australian Perfume Junkies: lasts around 4-5 hours, not a sillage monster but leaves a light trail.
